design_dna.card_and_cta_treatment: White cards with 1px #DDD3BC borders and a gold top rule on visit cards / teal top rule on why-cards; sharp rectangular buttons (2px radius) in gold and teal
design_dna.colour_system: Deep teal #123B3C primary, warm cream #FAF5EB base, muted gold #C2A15A accent, ink #1E2422 text; gold-dark #7A6428 for small text on cream (AA). No orange UI accents.
design_dna.hero_composition: Centred badge + background: a centred circular gold-ringed 'G' emblem badge with the restaurant name over a full-width dining-room photo background, headline beneath the badge — NOT split 50/50, NOT full-screen photo with huge headline, NOT type-led with one small image, NOT mosaic, NOT collage
design_dna.signature_elements: Bento-grid feature tiles (Dining / Events / Family / Takeaway); events & banquet/gatherings section (dark teal band); tabbed menu (Starters / Mains / Desserts); lightbox gallery
design_dna.type_pairing: Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Figtree (body) via Google Fonts

honesty_notes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards, staff or opening year. No verbatim review quotes — 'Why locals choose' paraphrases the 5 review themes from research.json.
Rating stated only as '3.9 stars, over 1,500 Google reviews' (counts conflict across snapshots). Hours 'Daily 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM' from Evendo/Google Business Profile.
'Prices on request' appears ONCE, in the menu section only; no prices anywhere.
Events section claims no banquet hall or capacity — gatherings framed as book-ahead family occasions. Takeaway framed as phone-ahead collection; no delivery-platform listing claimed.
Grace Family Restaurant details (kids' play area, CSD parking, Kabsa Dajaj, Turkish kebab) and the Dhaka Grandiose Restaurant were found in search and deliberately NOT used — different businesses.
Footer-only disclaimer verbatim: 'Design concept by CodeCrafters Hub — not the official website of Grandiose' Restaurant.' plus meta robots noindex. No concept/demo/mockup badges in hero or header.
